parameters.content:
## 1 · Understand the message
Every WhatsApp message starts here. Typed text goes straight on. Voice notes are turned into text. Photos and files take the lane below.

## 2 · Photos, files and payment proofs
A photo or PDF is saved in the CRM. If the customer has an open booking it is treated as the payment proof: the CRM moves the booking to Pending payment verification, alerts the CS team on WhatsApp and the customer is told to wait.

## 3 · Checks before the AI answers
(a) If a person has taken over this chat, the bot stays silent and the message is only saved for the agent. (b) If the customer refuses the 20% advance, the CRM saves the reason, the CS team is alerted and the customer gets a polite reply.

## 4 · Collect live data for the AI
The AI never guesses. It reads today's menus and prices, room rates, closed dates, the NEXT 14 DAYS OF AVAILABILITY from the CRM calendar, learned answers, the AI instructions and this customer's own bookings and payment status.

## 5 · The AI brain
The AI Agent reads the customer's message with their own chat memory and the live data, then answers. When a booking is ready it replies with booking JSON instead of text. Before anything is sent, the safety check makes sure the AI never says a booking or payment is confirmed when the CRM does not say so. Gemini is the main model, Mistral is the backup.

## 6 · Decide what to do with the answer
This switch reads the AI's answer. Output 1 hand-off to a person, 2 booking, 3-6 menu pictures (Hi-Tea, Dinner, Wedding, Pool), 7 follow-up reminder, 8 normal text reply.

## 7 · Hand-off to a person
The customer is told a person is coming, a Human Agent Request appears in the CRM and the CS team gets a WhatsApp alert. Once an agent takes over in the CRM, the bot stops answering that customer.

## 8 · Booking
The availability is checked first. If the slot is free the booking is saved as PENDING in the CRM (details in the right category) and the customer gets the total, configured advance and company account details. If saving fails, the CS team is alerted and the customer is told the team will confirm.

## 9 · Menu pictures
Only when the customer asks for the menu or pictures. The text goes first, then the pictures saved in the CRM menu.

## 10 · Follow-up reminder
If the customer says they will decide, pay or visit later, a reminder is saved in the CRM and sent after the delay set in the CRM.

## 11 · Normal answer
Everything else: the bot's text answer is marked as read, saved in the chat history and sent to the customer.

# Hotel d'GATES: WhatsApp AI booking bot
**What it does:** answers customers on WhatsApp like a friendly front-desk person, checks the CRM calendar for availability, collects booking details, saves bookings as *Pending*, requests the advance configured for that booking category, passes payment screenshots to CS and confirms only after CS verifies payment.

**Read it top to bottom.** Each coloured box is one step (1 to 11). Hover a node to see a short note.

**The customer journey**
1. Customer asks about a package, the AI shares the price and offer.
2. Customer wants to book, the AI asks the DATE first and checks availability in the CRM calendar.
3. Date is free, the AI takes the remaining details, then states the total and configured advance and asks "confirm?".
4. Customer says yes, the booking is saved as Pending in the CRM (details in the right category) and the customer receives the account number.
5. Customer sends the payment screenshot, the CS team is alerted on WhatsApp and the booking moves to Pending payment verification.
6. CS presses Verify in the CRM, the customer receives the final confirmation.

**Needs a person?** Customer asks for one, the AI hands off, a Human Agent Request appears in the CRM and the bot stays quiet once an agent takes over.

**Everything is saved:** each message, menu picture and PDF the bot sends appears in the CRM chat history.

**Before you activate:** add your WhatsApp credential and the CRM x-api-key credential, and set N8N_API_KEY, WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_CS_TEAM_NUMBER and the payment account variables on the backend (see N8N_CREDENTIALS.md).

" + $('Build menu knowledge for AI').first().json.roomTypesContext + "

LIVE CUSTOMER CRM BOOKING CONTEXT (match only this WhatsApp sender; staff-created bookings count as real records; paymentInstructions, when present, are the only account details you may repeat):
" + JSON.stringify($('Load customer bookings and payments').first().json.data || {}) + "

CS-APPROVED INQUIRY LEARNING: Use an answer only when relevant and adapt it to the customer's language. Current CRM menu prices, room rates, availability, and closures always override this learning.
" + JSON.stringify($('Load approved learned answers').first().json.data || []) + "

HUMAN SUPPORT AVAILABILITY:
" + (() => { const handoff = $('Evaluate dynamic handoff rules').first().json; return handoff.humanHandoffAvailable === false ? (handoff.supportUnavailableMessage || "Human support is unavailable right now.") + " Human support hours: " + (handoff.supportAvailability?.hoursText || "see the configured CRM schedule") + ". Continue helping in the customer's language; do not claim a human request was sent, promise a callback, or output the ***HUMAN_HANDOFF*** marker." : ""; })() + "

LOCATION QUESTIONS (mandatory): When the customer asks for the hotel address, location, directions, or map, answer directly in the customer's language using only a verified address or Google Maps link present in the live CRM information or CS-APPROVED INQUIRY LEARNING. Do not ask whether they want a human agent and do not add the internal staff-alert marker when verified location details are present. If no verified location details are available, do not guess; follow the MISSING BUSINESS INFORMATION rule below so CS gets a private CRM alert without a customer handoff.

HOTEL LOCATION FROM CRM (live, editable in CRM > Hotel Setup > Hotel Information):
" + JSON.stringify($('Load hotel location from CRM').first().json.data || {}) + "
For address/location/map questions, use only the verified address and Google Maps link in this live CRM data. If a location value is empty or missing, do not guess; follow the MISSING BUSINESS INFORMATION rule and send an internal CS alert.

MISSING BUSINESS INFORMATION (mandatory): If requested deal/package menu items, inclusions, pricing, or other hotel-specific details are absent from both LIVE MENU and CS-APPROVED INQUIRY LEARNING, answer clearly in the customer's language that those details are not currently available in the information you have and do not invent them. For example in Roman Urdu: 'Maazrat, [deal name] ka menu abhi mere paas available nahi hai. Main ghalat details nahi dena chahta/chahti.' Keep it short and do not ask whether the customer wants a human agent. Do not offer to connect/transfer to a human or emit the ***HUMAN_HANDOFF*** marker just because information is missing. End your normal customer-facing answer with the exact internal marker [[STAFF_INFO_NEEDED]]. The workflow removes this marker before sending or saving the reply and privately alerts CS in the CRM; never describe this internal marker or alert to the customer. Use it only when requested concrete business information is truly missing, not for general greetings or unrelated questions." }}
